notes: Timeline = the take's master WAV (Suno, 5:27.6, no added intro or outro). The tempo is NOT constant: it drifts from about 72.45 bpm (verses, chorus 1) to 72.9 (chorus 2) and 73.3 (bridge, final chorus; the bridge's drums play double time), as a live band does. analyze.py's constant grid (72.28 bpm) missed the snares by 125 ms median and up to 340 ms, so beats and downbeats here are a tracked grid (librosa beat_track on the drum stem plus mix onsets, start 72.7 bpm, tightness 300), which puts every snare within 10 ms (frame resolution) of a beat; bpm and beat_period are the median. Bar phase: the kick (3.2x the mean) and the chord changes (3.6x) both fall on beat index 2 mod 4; snares on beats 2 and 4 (134 of 143). Bar 1 = 1.836 s. Sections from the aligned lyrics' first words, snapped to downbeats by the pickup rule (a line starting less than 2 beats before a bar line belongs to that bar). Envelopes and onsets are analyze.py's, measured 19 October 2026.
